body:
- before:`expect(widget.render.args[0]).toMatchSnapshot();` is checking all args of the first call
- after:`expect(widget.render.mock.calls[0][0]).toMatchSnapshot();` is checking the first arg of the first call
I'm just bringing this up in case it's unwanted.

I think checking call order is now possible.
there should be a `mymock.mock.mockinvocationCallOrder`. At least it's inside a changelog https://github.com/facebook/jest/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md#fixes-11
I think it's a Jest's internal. Testing the call order doesn't bring much value IMO anyway.
